title: The Mathnawi of Jalaluddin Rumi, Vol. 1
author: Rumi (Nicholson ed)
description: The Mathnawi of Jalaluddin Rumi, Volume 1, edited by Reynold A. Nicholson (E. J. W. Gibb Memorial series, 1925 onward), Nicholson's monumental edition, translation and commentary on Rumi's masterpiece, which he completed over decades. This volume contains the critical Persian text of the first books of the Mathnawi, edited from the earliest manuscripts, with critical notes; Nicholson's English translation and commentary appear in companion volumes. Rumi's poem of some 25,000 couplets, beginning with the lament of the reed flute, teaches through tales, Qur'anic interpretation and metaphysical discourse the path of love, the annihilation of the self in God, the meaning of spiritual guidance and the hidden unity behind appearances. Nicholson's edition remains the standard text of the Mathnawi used by scholars worldwide and the basis of most modern translations.
